mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, email, phone, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, username, password, email, phone, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, username, password, email, phone, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM user WHERE deleted = 0
AND username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password, email, phone, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET username = #{username}, password = #{password}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
